title: Carl H. Pforzheimer, Jr. Professor of Teaching and Learning Faculty Co-Chair, Human Development and Education Program (HDE)
bio: Jon Star is an educational psychologist who studies children's learning of mathematics in middle and high school, particularly algebra. Star's current research explores the development of flexibility in mathematical problem solving.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
